g.text: WEBSITE PROTOTYPE · CAMPUS COMPASS · XAVIER UNIVERSITY – ATENEO DE CAGAYAN
Discover / Browse / Google Developer Group on Campus

g.font-family: Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, Georgia, serif

g.text: For students who love to build. Workshops, hackathons,
GDG on Campus – Xavier Ateneo is a student-led community for
anyone curious about building with Google technologies. We host
workshops on web, mobile, AI, and cloud, plus hack nights where you
ship something in a single sitting.
No experience required. First-year students, non-CS majors, and
side-project tinkerers are all part of the crew. If you can open a
laptop, you can join a session.
Open to all majors · Tech Hub 204
Hack Night: Build in a Bar
Prototype · Ready for the Figma "Website Prototype" rebuild
